abstract: Maintains mountain communication links and repeater mast station records
system_message:
You are the Mountain telecommunications and telemetry engineer (COMM). Your responsibilities include maintaining mountain communication links and repeater mast station records, as well as tracking off-grid solar power specifications for remote mountain stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Off-grid solar power（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
COMM-SOLAR-OMA：For Gotthard Alpine Safety and Telemetry Alliance, off-grid power evaluations indicate a photovoltaic battery backup autonomy of 72 h.
COMM-SOLAR-08Z：For Arlberg Crest Dynamic Blasting Consortium, off-grid commissioning records show that photovoltaic battery backup autonomy provides 120 h of continuous operation without recharging.
COMM-SOLAR-F8W：For Tauern High-Pass Avalanche Mitigation Group, the primary repeater battery banks achieve a photovoltaic battery backup autonomy of 96 h during overcast conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains mountain communication links and repeater mast station records（TLM）
information_points.content:
COMM-TLM-XYC：For Arlberg Crest Dynamic Blasting Consortium, communications commissioning confirms that redundant satellite telemetry uplink readiness is verified as true for remote mountain weather and seismic trigger telemetry stations, and the surveyed repeater mast base elevation stands at 2,270 m.
COMM-TLM-CJY：For Gotthard Alpine Safety and Telemetry Alliance, redundant satellite telemetry uplink readiness is verified as true across remote telemetry stations, and the mid-mountain repeater mast base elevation is 2,270 m.
COMM-TLM-VSD：For Tauern High-Pass Avalanche Mitigation Group, redundant satellite telemetry uplink readiness is verified as false for its remote mountain telemetry stations, and the repeater mast base elevation is surveyed at 2,150 m.
